headline: Week 8: start Breece Hall if active at about 8:30 AM Pacific, otherwise use Keaton Mitchell, and make sure a kicker is in by 10:00 AM Pacific.
alerts: Sleeper could not be reached again this run, so the roster is from the last successful pull. Check your lineup in the app.
Breece Hall (quad) is questionable after limited practices all week. Inactives post about 8:30 AM Pacific. Kickoff 10:00 AM Pacific.
Brian Robinson is OUT. Take him out of any lineup slot before 10:00 AM Pacific.
If you still have no kicker, add Chad Ryland (ARI at DAL, indoors, 54.5 total) before 10:00 AM Pacific.
Golden and Lloyd already played Thursday. Green Bay won 27-19.
Colts at Jaguars and Falcons at Bucs have rain and wind in the forecast. Downs is a lower-floor flex.
Daylight saving time ends tonight. Early games are 10:00 AM Pacific, Chargers-Rams 1:05 PM Pacific.

ARI.note: At Dallas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Cowboys -7, total 54.5. RB Jeremiyah Love returns from his ankle injury. OL Jon Gaines and DL Walter Nolen are out.

DAL.note: Hosts Arizona Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Cowboys about 31 implied. WR George Pickens is questionable. WR KaVontae Turpin is out.

GB.note: Beat Carolina 27-19 Thursday. Jordan Love threw 3 TDs. Golden played.

DET.note: Hosts Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Lions -3.5, total about 46. S Kerby Joseph is out.

MIN.note: At Detroit Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Only S Jay Ward is on the Vikings injury report.

IND.note: At Jacksonville Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jaguars -10, total 46.5. Rain and gusty wind expected. WR Anthony Gould is out.

LAC.note: At the Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Rams -6.5, total 45.5. S Derwin James and WR Brenen Thompson are out.

NYJ.note: Hosts Las Vegas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -1.5, total 45.5, mostly sunny. Hall questionable. Sweat and Ossai out, Bailey doubtful.

ATL.note: At Tampa Bay Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bucs -2.5, total 43.5, storms in the forecast. Brian Robinson is out.

WAS.note: Hosts Philadelphia Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Terry McLaurin is out for the season.

PHI.note: At Washington Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Hurts is on IR.

Props: 256.5 passing yards and 9.5 rushing yards. TD and INT lines were not found, so no prop projection is set.
Jeremiyah Love returns from his ankle injury, which may trim some pass volume.
